verdict.rationale: Postman documents its own event-bound automation: scripts that run automatically before a request is sent or after a response, and CLI-managed webhooks for event-driven integrations. However, nothing in the pack shows a general rule definition system (conditions mapped to actions) or how webhooks actually trigger actions. Missing for 10: a documented rule/trigger configuration model, a broader event catalog beyond request/response lifecycle, details on webhook-triggered actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Postman can run scripts before a request is sent (pre-request) or after (post-response).
Create, manage, and forward webhooks for event-driven integrations and local development.
